post.description: Runs a document through the same pipeline as generated output: schema, component and action registries, semantic rules, theme and design rules. Always returns 200; see `valid`.

get.description: Workspaces of the caller, most recent first.

post.description: A workspace holds one evolving UI, its version history and its conversation.

delete.description: Also deletes the workspace's versions, messages and action history.

get.description: Summary of the current application (screens, entities, design, counts) and its graph: which screens the navigation reaches, which actions lead from one screen to another, and which screens share data. 404 when the workspace holds a single view.

404.description: Unknown workspace, or it holds no application.

get.description: Every image prepared for the workspace, newest first, with its provenance.

post.description: Generates or finds one image and stores it. Returns the asset reference to add to the UI with an `ADD_ASSETS` operation; the workspace's UI is not changed here.

get.description: Messages of a workspace, oldest first.

post.description: Stores a message in the workspace's conversation without generating a UI. Use `POST /ui/generate` or `POST /ui/mutate` to send an instruction.

delete.description: Forgets every change made to the application's data while using it; the sample records of the current version are shown again. Versions are not affected.

get.description: Values submitted through forms in this workspace's UI, newest first.
Version history of a workspace, newest first. Versions are immutable.

post.description: Persists an approved proposal or manual edit. Send the complete `document` or the `operations` to apply to the base version; either is fully re-validated. The new version becomes current. Rejected with 409 when `base_version_id` is stale.

409.description: `base_version_id` is no longer the workspace's current version.

post.summary: Save an approved change as a new version

get.description: The stored UI document plus current rows for the datasets it binds.
Schema-based list of changes that turn this version into `with` (default: the current version).

post.description: Makes an earlier version current by appending a copy of it as the newest version. No existing version is changed or removed.

409.description: `base_version_id` is no longer the workspace's current version.
